STS2_LINNEA_CULTIVATE.title: Cultivate
STS2_LINNEA_CULTIVATE.description: Cultivate a Sapphire Seed into a Sapphire Flower.
SAPPHIRE_SEED.pages.INITIAL.options.LINN: Upgrade a card in your deck. Add a Sapphire Seed to your deck.
SAPPHIRE_SEED.pages.LINNEA_CARRY.descrip:
You cup the sapphire seed in your hands and carefully open your field guide, adding this curious new plant to its pages.

This place does not seem right for it to grow… Perhaps you should carry it with you for now?
STS2_LINNEA_EVENT_JUNGLE_DISCOVERY.title: A Jungle Discovery!
STS2_LINNEA_EVENT_JUNGLE_DISCOVERY.pages:
You pass through a shadowy jungle—and discover treasure!

Your pack has limited space… It seems you can take only one. Which will it be?
You tuck the pieces of gold into your pack and leave with Lumi.
You find several plants you have never seen before! You immediately open your field guide, record them, and take your leave.
Lumi swallows the ore before you… Does Lumi seem a little livelier?
STS2_LINNEA_EVENT_ORE_COLLECTOR.title: The Ore Collector
STS2_LINNEA_EVENT_ORE_COLLECTOR.pages.IN:
You enter a collector’s display room. Every jar contains a magnificent, gleaming mineral.

You have never seen so many curious stones… What will you do?
Upgrade {Upgrades} random cards in your deck.
Choose an upgraded card in your deck to remove.
You have no removable upgraded cards.
Pay {Price} Gold. Obtain a random Relic.
STS2_LINNEA_EVENT_ORE_COLLECTOR.pages.RE: You hastily take out your notes and begin writing. Every stone’s luster, every texture… All of it goes into your guide. How satisfying!
STS2_LINNEA_EVENT_ORE_COLLECTOR.pages.GI:
You take out a beautiful gem and place it in the only empty jar.

For this moment, the collection is complete.
STS2_LINNEA_EVENT_ORE_COLLECTOR.pages.BU:
Your gaze settles on a lovely topaz. Its surface is still unpolished, but you know what a beautiful gem it will become.

Adding a meaningful keepsake to your pack is more satisfying than keeping material wealth.
STS2_LINNEA_EVENT_SPIRIT_IN_THE_DUST.pag:
A tiny voice rises from beneath your feet. A wandering trace of a spirit seems about to fade away.

What could you do for it…?
Pay {Price} Gold to remove a Curse. Eternal Curses cannot be removed.

Moved by compassion, you lay a few simple offerings on the ground where the spirit is fading.

You feel a little lighter…

You reach out to the spirit’s last wandering trace… It gently circles your fingertips, as if thanking you for this final kindness.

You feel a little more energetic…
BRAIN_LEECH.pages.INITIAL.options.LINNEA: Downgrade a random card, then upgrade 2 random cards.
BRAIN_LEECH.pages.LINNEA_EXCHANGE.descri:
You do not agree hastily. Instead, you first try to talk with it.

It seems delighted by the negotiation and exchanges some of its own knowledge with you before leaving, satisfied.
